sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:55

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:55:1
items.html: In Bina there are ZON, and a son, who is the above Hesed: The male is the Yod that was born through the ZON of the vessel of Hochma. And the female is the record that remained in the vessel of Bina from the time of the first expansion. And the son that is there is the light of Hesed that Hochma bestowed to the vessel of Bina, after the ZON of Hochma refined to phase one, as above in item 51.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:55:2
items.html: And these ascents depend on the deeds of the lower ones. For at the time of Lo Mati in Hochma and Bina — since they refined to phase one and the level of HB vanished from the Partzuf — HB then rise to Keter; and through their ascent there, to the ZON of Keter, they cause the return of the coarseness of phase three to the screen of the ZON of Keter, and then they couple once more with the upper light and again draw the level of Hochma as at first. (As above in the Inner Light, page 321, the passage beginning “Mati in Keter,” study it there well.) And in this manner, in the second aspect of the expansion, that is, the Partzuf of Bina of AK, at the time of Lo Mati in Hochma, Bina, Hesed, Tifferet, Hod and Malchut, as above (in the Inner Light, page 343, the passage beginning “and already,” study it there), all the lights rise to Keter, to the ZON that are there, which causes the return of the coarseness of phase two to the screen there, and again the level of Bina emerges there as at first. And it is upon these two kinds of ascents — that is, the ascents of the second expansion, which is called the Partzuf of Hochma of AK, and the ascents of the second aspect of the perpetual expansion in Mati and Lo Mati, which is called the Partzuf of Bina of AK, as above in the words of the ARI (page 340, item 47) — that all the words of the ARI before us turn. And as for what he says, that they depend on the deeds of the lower ones, this was already explained above (in the Inner Light, page 346, the passage beginning “the deeds,” study it there).

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:55:3
items.html: Sometimes all five lights will rise, and sometimes only four will rise, and the light of Hesed, who is a son, remains below in the vessel of Bina. For in the Partzuf of Hochma only four lights rise, which are the ZON of the vessel of Hochma and the ZON of the vessel of Bina; but the light of Hesed, which includes all the seven lower ones, does not rise during the whole course of the second expansion of the first aspect, until the completion of that whole expansion, as above in item 46 and in the Inner Light, page 340, the passage beginning “and behold.” So that in all these emergences and entries of the lights into the vessels in the second expansion, only the four lights of HB alone rose to Keter, for only phase two refined and its level vanished into the root that is in Keter; but phase one did not refine until the end of the expansion, which is only at the coming of the lights to Yesod and Malchut, when they rise to the Malchut of the Rosh and that expansion is completed. And then the perpetual expansion of Mati and Lo Mati begins, which is called the Partzuf of Bina; and in this Partzuf five lights are found to rise, for here the light of Hesed, which includes all the seven lower ones, also rises to Keter, since here the Mati and Lo Mati applies perpetually — for every time it is Mati in Malchut, it is already after the refinement of phase one, and when Malchut too refines, all the lights rise to Keter. So that every time it is Lo Mati in Malchut, the five lights — which are the ZON of HB, and the Hesed that includes the seven lower ones — rise to Keter. And this is what he says, that sometimes four lights rise, namely in the Partzuf of Hochma, and sometimes five lights rise, namely in the Partzuf of Bina, as explained.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:55:4
items.html: Four lights are included only in the Nukva: For you know that there are a male and a female in the vessel of Keter. And in the Partzuf of Hochma of AK, which is the second expansion, there are two vessels there, one for the male and one for the female; and therefore, when the lights rise to Keter, they all come — that is, the four lights — to the vessel of the female, for she is the one who receives them into herself as MAN, and not the male, since all ascents as MAN are only to the female. However, when five lights rise — which can be pictured only in the Partzuf of Bina, where the Mati and Lo Mati is perpetual, and every time it is Lo Mati in Malchut all the lights rise as MAN to Keter, that is, including Hesed, as above — since in the Partzuf of Bina there is no more than a single vessel, that of the male, in which the Nukva too clothes, as the ARI writes before us, the lights must therefore rise to the vessel of the male, since the Nukva is there as well.
